question: Choose the correct one-word substitute for “A specialist who drafts maps.”
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 - Cartographer**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"specialist"** refers to someone who has expert knowledge or skills in a particular field. (विशेषज्ञ)

 
 
• **Example:** He consulted a specialist to get the best advice on his medical condition.
 
 
 
• A **cartographer** is a specialist who drafts maps. This involves studying geographic information and creating visual representations of areas. (मानचित्रकार)
 
 
• **Example:** The cartographer worked tirelessly to create an accurate map of the newly discovered island.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 - Cartographer**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Topographer** (स्थलाकृतिक मानचित्रकार): A person who studies and maps the surface features of the land.

 
 
• **Example:** The topographer created a detailed map of the mountain range.
 
 
 
• **Geologist** (भूवैज्ञानिक): A scientist who studies the Earth, its materials, and the processes that shape it.
 
 
• **Example:** The geologist examined the rock samples to determine their age.
 
 
 
• **Archivist** (अभिलेखागार विशेषज्ञ): A person responsible for preserving and organizing historical records and documents.
 
 
• **Example:** The archivist carefully restored ancient manuscripts in the library.
